NOTE
**Still not ready: commits still don't follow the guide, and the screenshot request is unresolved**

New: The author squashed the fixup commits (4 down to 2) and added a regression test, but the code is unchanged. Missing: the commit titles are still "fix for issue 17419" and "added test case for issue 17418" (wrong number), not Zulip-style `area: Summary.` messages. The test is also still a separate commit instead of being part of the fix. There are still no precise before/after screenshots or a screen recording.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have laurynmm (who gave the feedback) reply, since nobody is assigned.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for squashing! The commits still need to follow the [commit discipline](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) guide: use a title like `markdown: Preserve tabs in fenced code blocks.`, reference `Fixes: #17419`, and fold the test into the same commit as the fix. A short screen recording works for the before/after; please follow the [precise before/after guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
